code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row) - {background}
    for color in colors:
        points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        paired = set()
        # Connect points sharing either diagonal direction.
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(points):
            for r2, c2 in points[i+1:]:
                if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r2 != r1:
                    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
                    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
                    for k in range(1, abs(r2-r1)):
                        out[r1 + dr*k][c1 + dc*k] = color
                    paired.update(((r1,c1),(r2,c2)))
        # An unpaired marker emits a down-right diagonal to the grid edges.
        for r, c in points:
            if (r, c) not in paired:
                rr, cc = r, c
                while rr >= 0 and cc >= 0:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr -= 1; cc -= 1
                rr, cc = r+1, c+1
                while rr < h and cc < w:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr += 1; cc += 1
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    ones = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    pair_lines = []
    for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if r1 != r2 and abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1):
                slope = 1 if (r2-r1)*(c2-c1) > 0 else -1
                pair_lines.append((r1,c1,r2,c2,slope))
                dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
                dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
                for k in range(abs(r2-r1)+1):
                    rr,cc = r1+dr*k,c1+dc*k
                    if grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = 1
    # A 6 marker on a 1 segment activates perpendicular full diagonals for all 6 markers.
    active_slopes = set()
    for r1,c1,r2,c2,slope in pair_lines:
        for r,c in sixes:
            if (r-r1)*(c2-c1) == (c-c1)*(r2-r1) and min(r1,r2) <= r <= max(r1,r2) and min(c1,c2) <= c <= max(c1,c2):
                active_slopes.add(slope)
    for slope in active_slopes:
        # slope is sign of delta-column / delta-row; perpendicular diagonal has opposite sign.
        for r,c in sixes:
            rr,cc = r,c
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if grid[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = 6
                rr -= 1
                cc += 1 if slope == 1 else -1
            rr,cc = r+1,c+(-1 if slope == 1 else 1)
            while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                if grid[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = 6
                rr += 1
                cc += -1 if slope == 1 else 1
    return out
'''
